verdict: The framing and original rain doodle identity read clearly, but the source event is only partly represented in the viewed samples.
one_gap_that_matters_most: The source develops from scattered road impacts into a broad, visibly churning sheet of rain and splash across the road, strongest around source-05 through source-07. The paired keys retain roughly the same sparse rainfall and faint isolated rings, so that buildup has little visual force.
smallest_repair: Keep the existing rain strokes and framing. Strengthen only the time-varying road-impact layer so the middle-to-late burst spreads farther across the road and overlaps more visibly at the source peak, then eases with the source. Use the same simple faint hand-drawn rings and tiny impact marks already present.
must_not_be_lost: The nine irregular straight-or-kinked strokes of the original doodle, their spare dark-line character, the quiet paper field, and the accurately centered converging rails and road perspective.
source_framing: Met in still samples: central road vanishing point, bilateral bridge rails, horizon height, left vertical structure, and right tree/post landmarks correspond well.
original_doodle_identity: Met in still samples: the distinctive uneven rain strokes remain immediately recognizable across the keys; the added scene remains subordinate.
motion_review: No actual normal-speed playback occurred. I visually inspected only the supplied still media; comparison.mp4 was not visually viewed, so fall timing, continuity, looping, and source synchronization are unverified.
